entities.name: Volta Regional Museum
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Volta Regional Museum is a museum in Ho, Ghana. The museum is dedicated to the history and traditions of the Volta Region. The museum is administered by the Ghana Museums and Monuments Board.
